title: Planeswalker's Guide to Return to Ravnica Part 2

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The guild-ruled city plane described in this guide.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: A guild of obsessive experimenters led by the dragon Niv-Mizzet, whose experiments often produce mana geysers, spatial rifts or arcane portals.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: A 15,000-year-old, vain, temperamental, super-intelligent dragon who is the original parun of the Izzet League and secretly runs the Interlocus.

entities.name: Izmundi
entities.description: Niv-Mizzet's court of servants; the Izmagnus are its most powerful members.

entities.name: Nivix
entities.description: A massive tower, central guildhall of the Izzet and home of Niv-Mizzet.

entities.name: Blistercoils
entities.description: A recently constructed series of gigantic water wheels with mizzium coils that generate volatile mana.

entities.name: Boilerpits
entities.description: Underground passageways of intertwined high-pressure pipelines used for risky Izzet experiments.

entities.name: Mizzium Foundry
entities.description: The only place on Ravnica where mizzium alloy is smelted, guarded by viashino.

entities.name: Interlocus
entities.description: A secret scattered grand meta-project that Niv-Mizzet conducts through the Izzet's experiments.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: The guild that fuses life and death, disposing of carcasses and reclaiming decaying districts.

entities.name: Jarad Vod Savo
entities.description: The Golgari guildmaster, an undead elvish necromancer lich who sacrificed himself to save his son from Rakdos.

entities.name: Savra
entities.description: Jarad's ambitious late sister and a former matka of the Devkarin.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: The demon from whom Jarad saved his son.

entities.name: Cilia
entities.description: Jarad's council of shamans and rogues acting as advisory parliament and spy agency.

entities.name: Devkarin
entities.description: A race of elves of shadow and a main Golgari power group pressing for expansion.

entities.name: Zdenia
entities.description: The current matka of the Devkarin, a black-haired young woman tattooed with insects and spiders.

entities.name: Lotleth
entities.description: The Golgari's irregular faction of undead and necromancers.

entities.name: Wratislav
entities.description: The conceited human necromancer who leads the Lotleth.

entities.name: Street Swarm
entities.description: The Golgari labor class of scavengers, shamans, rot farmers and kraul.

entities.name: Korozda
entities.description: The new Golgari guildhall, lair of Jarad Vod Savo.

entities.name: Deadbridge
entities.description: A Golgari-controlled neighborhood built around a large sinkhole used to dispose of corpses.

entities.name: Zanikev
entities.description: A large Golgari reclamation zone of ruined former neighborhoods.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: The guild covered in Part 1 of the guide and mentioned here.

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet drives the Izzet to delve into ever more dangerous and experimental magic for unknown purposes.
events.quote: their guild leader, Niv-Mizzet , has driven the Izzet to delve deeper and deeper into more dangerous and experimental magic

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet secretly conducts a scattered grand meta-project he calls the Interlocus.
events.quote: secretly, Niv-Mizzet is conducting a scattered, grand meta-project he calls the Interlocus

events.summary: Jarad Vod Savo rises as a lich after sacrificing himself to save his son from the demon Rakdos.
events.quote: Jarad learned the ways of necromancy and was able to rise as a lich after sacrificing himself to save his son from the demon Rakdos.

events.summary: Jarad survives several assassination attempts by feeding off his challengers' power.
events.quote: He has survived several assassination attempts from various upstarts, using the power of necromancy to feed off the power of his challengers.

events.summary: Jarad holds his position by reclaiming derelict districts, expecting the Devkarin and Lotleth to eventually dethrone him.
events.quote: He knows the power-hungry Devkarin elves and the decomposing Lotleth undead will eventually dethrone him
